description: Headless document rendering facade: one call takes a template (or plain document) plus token values and produces a WYSIWYG PDF (RenderPdfAsync = DocumentAssemblyService.Assemble → ITempoDocumentLayoutService → TempoDocumentPdfRenderer, incl. watermark and forensic watermark passthrough) or per-page PNG previews at a parametrizable DPI (RenderPageImagesAsync — visual feedback for agents, tests and preview tooling). Register via AddTempoDocumentServices().
